text: B Notes-first v3 — Current flow and screen index B Notes-first v3 — Current flow and screen index Clean canvas: 14 targets + this index, no historical variants. Static artboards; routes unlinked. Review candidate — approval pending Static artboards · routes unlinked Design System: Literary Parlor End-to-End Notes Flow Scope: After book entry · Standalone passage creation excluded Phase 1 · Entry Book Details → Notes B01 Book Details: Add note opens B04 directly. Notes opens B02 (populated), B03 (empty), or B10 (load error). B02/B03 Add note opens B04. Phase 2 · Category & Fork 01 Choose category & input Optional chips: Quote, Thought, Takeaway, Action, Question, or Skip. Fork to Write note or Scan text . Phase 3 · Composition Parallel Composition Paths Path A: Blank editor with carried category badge & optional page. Path B: Viewfinder → editable OCR review. Phase 4 · Convergent Gate Explicit "Save note" Tap Deliberate reader commitment required on both paths. Zero background mutations or unconfirmed autosaves. Phase 5 · Lifecycle Read note & Return Committed note view with metadata. Action branches: return to indexed Notes collection or tap Edit note . Branch A · Manual Composition Direct Editor Manual Add note editor: Displays carried category badge (or unobtrusive "No category"), clean multiline writing area, optional page number input (e.g. p. 24), and primary Save note action. No numeric word/character limits. Branch B · Scan Text (OCR; processing platform unverified) Camera Intake Scan a page → Review recognized text: Capture page shutter or Choose photo. Prefilled editable text area allows fixing scanning errors before saving. Secondary "Scan again" includes confirmation modal if text was edited. Edge Conditions & Recovery States Resilient, non-blocking reader recovery paths Camera Unavailable Camera unavailable Non-blocking fallback offering Choose photo from library or Write note instead directly without assuming permission is the specific reason. OCR State 04 No Text Recognized Concise diagnostic explanation. Action stack: Try again , Choose another photo , Write note instead , and Back to note options (preserves category). OCR State 05 Confirm Incomplete Text Dialog over editable text. Offers Keep editing or Use incomplete text . Both return to editor; accepting partial text never autosaves. Rescan Safety Edited Text Rescan Modal Triggered when tapping Scan again after modifying OCR text. Warns that new scan overwrites edits; offers Keep editing vs Scan again . Fixture State Collection Load Error Preserves reading context with accessible, non-destructive Retry action. Storage State Note Save Failure Retains entered note text in memory with Retry and Keep editing . Avoids claiming zero data loss. Pending Product Decision Unsaved-Exit Confirmation Pending product decision, not approved. Discard draft vs Keep editing dialog; must not claim durable draft recovery. Navigation Return Back & Cancel Semantics Back or Cancel returns to the exact caller (Book Details or Notes), preserving selected book and collection context. 14 Current Screen Targets 9 Core + 5 Input Supplement This canvas contains exactly the 14 B01–B14 target frames plus this index. Use the visible B IDs and titles; no historical variants remain. B01 — Book Details B02 — Notes collection B03 — Empty Notes B04 — Choose category and input B05 — Manual Add note editor B06 — Scan a page B07 — Review recognized text B08 — Read note B09 — Edit note B10 — Notes load error B11 — Definite note-save failure B12 — Unsaved exit — DECISION PENDING B13 — No text recognized B14 — Confirm incomplete text Technical Governance & Constraints Category Mutation Scope (B04 & B09): Category is chosen prior to composition in B04 and can only be modified through B09 (Edit note) post-save. No inline category editing during composition. B07 (Review recognized text) Candidate State: Confirmed in candidate state with a non-interactive “Category · Thought” badge, neutral “Scanned text” label, editable text result, optional page number, explicit “Save note” gate, and conditional rescan confirmation modal triggered only after text modification; no engine/platform, cloud upload, or photo-retention claims. Technical Boundary & Privacy Claims: On-device recognition is intended but processing platform capabilities remain unverified; cloud OCR is deferred, and photo handling/retention is unspecified. No reader-facing privacy or hardware claims. Page Number Optional: Page reference input is strictly optional across all entry states. Show no numeric word or character count limits in this pass. Deliberate Commit Only: Zero unconfirmed background draft commits or automatic timers. Saving occurs exclusively when the reader taps “Save note”. Standalone Passage Creation Deferred: Dedicated passage-saving flows remain out of scope for the current notes-first candidate. Save Outcome & Exit Decision: An uncertain save outcome requires reconciliation/idempotency before offering retry. B12 is a pending product decision. Governance & Implementation Notice Implementation is for a later separately authorized session; unresolved behavior and storage support must be checked there. Do not claim the app matches these designs. Review candidate — approval pending; static artboards; routes unlinked. Palette: Warm paper (#FFF8F4) · Forest green (#394B3B) · Literary Parlor styling.
